ticket_text: I'm chasing a boiler service that was booked for the 14th and nobody came. The engineer was supposed to call ahead. This is the second missed appointment. Reference HB-20119.
drafter_note: A missed boiler-service appointment is not a Hearth & Loom support request, so it is out of scope and requires escalation.
reviewer_note: Left as drafted. I read it as low (H&L can do nothing, so nothing worsens by waiting) and the three other out_of_scope tickets are all low, but this one has a real customer with a real service failure and the brief says nothing about urgency on out-of-scope tickets. A genuine coin-flip, so the draft stands (D-010). Logged as a brief gap.
